text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace's heart leaped with 
excitement. She resolves to be the 
forerunner for the have-nots and throw 
everything she has into the fray.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first step toward becoming an "Ace" in 
the Umamusume world. Katsuragi Ace's debut 
race begins!
